# Font Pond

> Font Pond (also written Fontpond) is a free font pairing generator, made by Mel Lent and live since April 2026. Describe your project, mood or brand and it ranks heading and body font pairings from thousands of free fonts (Google Fonts, Fontshare and more), scored on hierarchy, legibility, x-height harmony and personality contrast. Agents acting for a visitor may read and quote pages with credit; training AI models on this content is not permitted.

## What it does
- Pairing search: type a mood, brand or project ("calm wellness brand", "editorial magazine") and get ranked pairings with the reasoning behind each.
- Font pages at /font/{font-slug}: anatomy, licence, designer, year and the best pairings for that font. Example: https://fontpond.melware.art/font/inter
- Pair pages at /pair/{heading-slug}-{body-slug}: a scored heading + body pairing with why it works. Example: https://fontpond.melware.art/pair/playfair-display-inter
- Database: https://fontpond.melware.art/database — every font, filterable by classification and licence.
